So the condition is: for all $1 \leq k < n$, $n \nmid k(q-1)$ and $n \nmid k(q^2-1)$.

So we need $\gcd(n, q-1) = 1$ and $\gcd(n, q^2-1) = 1$.

Since $q^2 - 1 = (q-1)(q+1)$, the condition $\gcd(n, q^2-1) = 1$ implies $\gcd(n, q-1) = 1$ and $\gcd(n, q+1) = 1$.

So we need $\gcd(n, q^2-1) = 1$, i.e., $\gcd(n, (q-1)(q+1)) = 1$.
